title: Python Fundamentals for Java Developers
description: Python for programmers who already know Java: syntax and dynamic typing, functions and arguments, the built-in collections, slicing and comprehensions, mutability and aliasing, modules and virtual environments, exceptions and logging, running script files, and testing with pytest.
sourceCoverageNotes: Course slice: Standard S14-S19 (/tracks/1/weeks/2/days/3..4, /tracks/1/weeks/3/days/0..3) and Fast FT9-FT11 (/tracks/2/weeks/1/days/3..4, /tracks/2/weeks/2/days/0). This module covers S14 rows 0-3 and S15 rows 0-4, which are exactly the nine FT9 rows.
Module grouping is a second-mate grouping decision (closing source-gap-python-modules), not syllabus: modules follow calendar day sequence, S14-S15 here.
FT9 '(skim)' rows (mutability, exceptions and logging, script files) map to the same canonical topics; skim is Fast-track emphasis metadata, not a separate page.

No module coding lab: the confirmed expected-artifact scope gives S14-S15 Concept-day topics no lab overlay; simulators carry the practice, and the data-pipelines module lab reuses venv, script and pytest skills on the real toolchain.
